audit_items.proof_trace: The authorize endpoint validates redirect_uri via isValidRedirectUri (route.ts:L94), but handleConsent reads redirect_uri from user-controlled FormData (actions.ts:L19) and never re-validates it against the registered URIs. It directly stores the FormData value as the auth code's redirect_uri in the DB (L86) and redirects the authorization code there (L106-109). The token endpoint's matching check (token/route.ts:L90) compares the attacker-stored value against the attacker-supplied token request, so it does not recover the invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated user at the consent page modifies the hidden redirect_uri input via browser devtools from the registered URI to an arbitrary attacker-controlled URI and submits the form; handleConsent stores the tampered URI in the authorization code record and redirects the auth code there, after which the attacker calls /oauth/token with the same URI to exchange the code for an access token.
